name: Bone-Bison de guerre
lore: La créature est adaptée d’un concept de production attribué à Jerad S. Marantz, consulté via une reproduction secondaire. Son dressage, son équipement et son emploi comme monture de guerre sont des créations du jeu.

assets.label: Bone Bison — corps de référence couleur
assets.prompt: Create a faithful 2D painted GAME SPRITE adaptation of the large BONE BISON creature in the supplied colour side-view concept attributed to Jerad S. Marantz. Preserve this exact unusual silhouette: huge high narrow bristly shoulder hump rising steeply from a very LOW long bowed neck, compact massive body tapering to a much lower rear, long downward-curved nose ending near the ground in a huge forward sweeping upward-tipped broad dark keratin horn, small recessed warm eye high behind the nose, dark blue-grey angular overlapping organic armour scutes interspersed with brown leathery/furred grooves along flanks and legs, brown dorsal bristle ridge and a thick short pointed plated tail extending down and behind. This is NOT an Earth buffalo/rhino/elephant: no buffalo head, no round ears, no elephant trunk, no branching antlers, no metal plates. Exactly FOUR stout functional legs, two front and two rear, clearly distinguish all four feet with a slightly staggered idle stance. Anatomy and plate distribution must remain coherent in both orientations. Exactly TWO whole-body side profiles SIDE BY SIDE, first facing RIGHT, second facing LEFT, no perspective depth. Equal scale and baseline. No rider, saddle, reins, armour attachments, human scale figure or ground. Preserve the enormous distinctive curved front horn entirely inside each half. Pure flat MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadow. Wide 10-percent clear margins and centre gutter. No text, reference captions, watermark, logos, UI or scenery. Detailed original bitmap rendering based on the concept, not a copy of the reference composition. Do not mix other black design variants into this colour design.

assets.label: Bone Bison — selle de guerre originale
assets.prompt: Create an independent removable riding-saddle module designed to fit the Bone Bison body just shown. This equipment is an ORIGINAL GAME INVENTION, not claimed movie canon. Show NO creature or rider. Exactly TWO separate complete saddle assemblies side by side, one oriented RIGHT then the other LEFT. Each has one compact low dark leather seat placed BEHIND the enormous shoulder hump, short bronze mounting rail, open curved padded frame shaped to the declining back, two modest stirrups and broad natural leather belly straps hanging free; avoid rigid bands over the raised hump. No spikes or weapon, no tusks, skulls or anatomy. Side elevation, same scale both views. Original weathered dark bronze Yautja craft, restrained engraved geometric detail, no readable writing. Matte magenta #FF00FF background, no shadows, big blank margins. All strap ends and stirrups completely visible and separated from the other assembly. Detailed painted game bitmap matching the provided creature's art style. Mechanical saddlery attachment must be coherent and all parts connected to the saddle; do not draw a rider-shaped void or animal body filler.

assets.label: Bone Bison — garde de flanc originale
assets.prompt: Create a separate modular protective FLANK GUARD for the supplied Bone Bison's optional original game war equipment. NO creature, animal anatomy, rider or saddle in this image. Exactly TWO independently illustrated side views side by side: first a RIGHT-facing set, second LEFT-facing corresponding set. Each is one low curved flexible guard with THREE overlapping dark bronze plates, thick leather edge trim and two short upper mounting tabs intended to hang from a saddle just behind the giant shoulder hump and above the legs. Broad curved underside leaves leg motion free. Preserve same three plates and proportions in each view. No horn, tusk, face, skull, dangling chain, weapons or writing. Worn Yautja geometric craftsmanship, fine amber connector light only, not magical. Orthographic side-view 2D painted game bitmap, crisp extractible silhouettes, pure flat magenta #FF00FF background. Wide margins, no shadow, no grid or labels. Design an independent attachment, not armour baked onto the animal. This military use is an original game adaptation rather than a canon assertion.

assets.label: Bone Bison — marche droite, premier essai
assets.rejectionReason: Collisions du contour détouré avec quatre frontières de cellule : 4, 3, 4 et 3 pixels (14 pixels au total) ; remplacement walk-right-r2 disponible.
assets.prompt: Create one production 2D side-scrolling game animation sprite sheet based exactly on the attached established Bone Bison body design. This is the SAME animal, not a redesign: blue-grey layered organic bony plates, large shoulder hump with brown bristly mane, very low long head with a huge broad upward-curving lower horn, short armoured tail, exactly FOUR weight-bearing legs and cloven dark feet. No rider, no saddle, no harness, no manufactured armor, no text. Use the attached RIGHT-facing animal as the consistent identity reference. Every sprite faces RIGHT in true orthographic side view. One complete slow WALK cycle of SIX distinct sequential frames arranged in a perfectly regular 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then next row. Frame order: left hind lift/push, left hind plant/right fore lift, right fore plant, right hind lift/push, right hind plant/left fore lift, left fore plant returning toward first frame. Preserve exactly four legs in every frame; legs move at the joints, NEVER duplicate feet or append ghost limbs. Near and far legs separated enough to read, the hidden far pair modestly darker. Horn shape, skull, dorsal plate pattern, mass and body proportions remain fixed; subtle shoulder/hip weight shift, very small head bob. Animation stays in place, no travel across cells. Same scale in all 6 square cells, centered same body origin and common foot contact baseline. Show the COMPLETE horn, mane, tail and feet in each cell, with at least 10 percent safety margin all around; no touching neighboring cells. Crisp detailed hand-painted raster game art with sharp readable contour matching the reference, no smear/motion blur. Wide image 1536 x 1024, each cell exactly 512 x 512. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF key background with no shadows, no gradients, no grid lines, no captions. The creature itself contains no magenta pixels.
notes: Nouvelle vague isolée du paquet V34 gelé. Quatre membres visibles ; appuis et continuité à revoir en mouvement. Marges horizontales inférieures au brief ; aucune animation acceptée dans le moteur.
Rejet technique complet : cellules 0, 1, 3 et 4 en collision de bord (14 pixels cumulés).

assets.label: Bone Bison — marche gauche, premier essai
assets.rejectionReason: Collisions du contour détouré avec cinq frontières de cellule : 7, 8, 7, 12 et 9 pixels (43 pixels au total) ; remplacement walk-left-r2 disponible.
assets.prompt: Generate a complementary six-frame WALK LEFT sprite sheet of the exact Bone Bison creature shown in the attached two-direction identity reference and right-walk sheet. Preserve original identity: huge bristly brown shoulder hump, blue-grey overlapping organic bony plates, low sweeping long head and oversized upcurved lower horn, short pointed armoured tail and exactly FOUR legs. Use the LEFT-facing identity specimen for this side. NOT a buffalo or rhino. No mechanical armour, saddle, rider, straps, accessories, captions or scenery. Every pose faces LEFT in a strict orthographic side view. Six genuinely sequential poses of a slow four-beat walking cycle, 3 equal columns x 2 equal rows, 1536x1024 total. Each frame occupies a 512x512 cell. The creature should occupy ONLY 78 percent of each cell width, ensuring at least 50 pixels empty margin on both sides, including the very tip of the horn and tail. Maintain identical scale and the same shoulder and grounded foot baseline positions across all six cells; animation in place. Show exactly four distinct legs, two near, two far darkened, no extra ghost legs or duplicated feet. Frame1 near rear starts lifting; frame2 near rear reaches forward and plants while near fore lifts; frame3 near fore plants; frame4 far rear lifts; frame5 far rear plants while far fore lifts; frame6 far fore plants and connects to frame1. The two halves must use different near versus far leg actions rather than repeat identical steps. Keep plate pattern, horn length/shape, body volume and colour invariant. Small natural shoulder/hip movement, no whole-body zoom. Feet flex at joints, no motion blur. Sharp detailed raster painted game art matching the identity, no perspective rotation. Uniform flat pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no ground shadow, grid lines, labels, color swatches or numbers. Whole animal inside every cell. This is an animation production source sheet, not a poster or collage.
notes: Vague suivante en attente de revue en mouvement. Quatre membres présents ; mouvement et raccord à valider. Certaines marges très étroites ; planche non acceptée pour le moteur.
Rejet technique complet : cellules 1, 2, 3, 4 et 5 en collision de bord (43 pixels cumulés).

Keep the canvas exactly1536x1024 with exactly3 columns and2rows. Each animal INCLUDING its horn and tail must fit within an imaginary rectangle from cell x=65 to x=447, and y=130 to y=380. That means the entire animal width must be at most382 pixels, NEVER near500. Do not draw rectangles or guides. Preserve the SIX DIFFERENT walking poses in their current reading order and retain all4legs per pose, original bony plate pattern, brown bristly hump, horn profile and pointed tail. Keep identical scale and aligned planted-foot groundline in all cells. Everything faces RIGHT. Do not simplify the creature, redesign anatomy, add/remove limbs, add new equipment, turn its head, add shadows, add text or change the six-cell arrangement. Only fix the too-large sprite footprints and any tiny contour crossing at the cell boundaries. Flat pure MAGENTA#FF00FF background, crisp detailed 2D painted game sprite contours. Large blank padding is intentional and essential for reliable animation extraction.
notes: Remplace la r1 dont la corne coupe une frontière de cellule. Source générée à nouveau par OpenAI, jamais réduite par un outil externe. Revue de la démarche encore requise.
Revue technique r2 : six cellules distinctes, aucune collision de bord ; anatomie, appuis et raccord cyclique restent à valider avant tout clip runtime.
